title: I asked Claude to make my Minecraft demo in ASCII
author: dechichi

comments.author: dechichi
comments.body:
I was inspired by this \[ASCII MMO RPG\](https://x.com/Ekimko/status/2111347724071088497?s=20) and decided to turn one of my engine demos into an ASCII renderer.

The rendering pipeline is still regular rasterization, and at the end I run a deferred shader pass per character cell to pick the glyph.

Instead of converting the final image by brightness like most ASCII post-processing shaders, the g-buffer also stores which block material and face each pixel shows. So every cell gets picked from what's actually there (e.g grass, stone, foliage, water, etc)

This is from a Minecraft demo I built in my engine which I have been building for 2 years now (yup, before AI), runs in the browser: [https://kaigen3d.com/demos/asciicraft](https://kaigen3d.com/demos/asciicraft)
